integrity: Analytical unrestricted proof and explicit positive construction included; a pure-Python exact-rational checker is supplied. Finite tests are supplementary, not proof of all real parameters. No external article texts are republished.
scientific_limitations: Real Banach targets; equal sized source blocks in a unit equilateral space; exactly two added points with opposite two-level distances; admissible full parameter domain only. Independent mathematical validation is not performed; less-indexed finite projection literature may contain an equivalent formula.
title: Sharp two-centre extension norms for balanced equilateral metric frames
